zh: 新增极窄与重叠碰撞自适应降级机制：当右侧工作区或浏览器侧边栏过宽导致中间对话顶栏被极度挤压、或标题与功能按钮发生重叠碰撞时，操作区自动丝滑收拢为优雅的「更多操作（···）」毛玻璃下拉菜单，完整保留工作区、浏览器、终端、日志快照与状态指示，彻底杜绝文字与图标重叠。
对话顶栏功能区（工作区、浏览器、终端、导出日志、新对话、浏览工具）全面升级矢量图标与平滑过渡动画；在右侧工作区、内置浏览器、终端侧边栏展开或窄屏挤压时，自适应收拢为优雅美观的纯图标模式，彻底杜绝换行折叠与遮挡对话内容。
智能体状态雷达自适应支持紧凑模式，在挤压状态下智能折叠长文案并保留脉冲呼吸灯与运行/阻塞数量角标，中英双语提示（title / aria-label）无缝对齐。
频道运营计划支持按专题或指定单个功能亮点（如会话共享、长期记忆、上下文管理）定向生成，新增 Dragon Claw 工作技巧模版。
增强 Windows 便携版自更新原子替换与容灾机制：支持进程退出重试与 EBUSY 共享冲突等待，替换失败自动回退旧版并保留原程序。
en: Introduced ultra-narrow and collision degradation dropdown: when sidebars heavily squeeze the center chat column or when the title collides with buttons, actions automatically collapse into an elegant More Actions (···) glassmorphism menu with zero text overlap.

Refined chat action buttons (workspace, browser, terminal, export log, new chat, browse tools) with vector icons and smooth transition animations; auto-collapsing to compact icon mode without multi-line wrapping when squeezed by sidebars or narrow viewports.
Added compact responsive state for Agent Status Radar, preserving live pulse indicator and running/blocked counts while gracefully hiding long labels when space is tight.

Channel operations plans now support targeting specific feature highlights (e.g., chat sharing, persistent memory, context compaction) alongside random rotation, adding Dragon Claw productivity templates.
Enhanced Windows portable app self-updater reliability with atomic executable replacement, automatic EBUSY retries, and safe rollback on failure.
